faqs.question: What is the VC-50 used for?
faqs.answer: It's a 50-watt hand-held ultrasonic processor for routine small-volume sample disruption, mixing, and de-agglomeration.

faqs.question: How do I control the ultrasonic power output?
faqs.answer: Turn the amplitude knob on the front panel; there's no programmed interface to navigate.

faqs.question: What sample volumes does the standard probe handle?
What's the difference between VC-50-110 and VC-50A-110?
faqs.answer: VC-50-110 includes both the converter and a probe; VC-50A-110 includes the converter only, without a probe.

faqs.question: Can I use my own probe with VC-50?
faqs.answer: Yes, order the VC-50A-110 configuration, which ships with the converter but not a probe, for use with your own compatible probe.

faqs.question: How do I know if VC-50 is powerful enough for my work?
faqs.answer: Confirm your target sample volume and required intensity; volumes larger than 15mL or higher power needs may fit better with the VCX-130 range instead.

faqs.question: Does VC-50 require any software or programming?
faqs.answer: No, operation is entirely manual through the front panel amplitude knob.

faqs.answer: Get in touch and Inkarp will put together a quote based on your probe and SKU configuration.

longForm.heroHook: Hold the probe, turn the knob. That's the whole operation.
longForm.heroLead: Not every sonication job needs a programmable interface and a menu of settings. Sometimes the work just needs reliable ultrasonic energy, on demand, without a learning curve. VC-50 delivers 50 watts of ultrasonic power through a hand-held probe, activated by turning the amplitude knob directly on the front panel. No software, no programmed sequences, just direct control over the energy going into your sample. The standard 1/4" probe handles 0.5 to 15mL volumes, small enough for routine disruption, mixing, and de-agglomeration work at the bench. Order it complete with converter and probe, or choose the probe-free configuration if you're building your own setup or already have compatible probes on hand.

sections.title: Simple Operation and Probe Configuration
sections.description: VC-50 operation: hand-held probe with direct front panel amplitude control.
paragraphs: There's no interface to learn on VC-50. The probe is held by hand, positioned directly in the sample, and ultrasonic energy activates by turning the amplitude knob on the front panel, immediate, direct control over how much energy reaches the sample.

The standard probe covers 0.5 to 15mL, matched to routine small-volume bench work rather than large-batch processing. Two ordering paths exist depending on what your lab already has: the complete VC-50-110 configuration ships with converter and probe together, while VC-50A-110 ships with the converter alone, letting you supply your own compatible probe.
sections.note: Tell us your typical sample volume, and we'll confirm the right probe size and SKU for your VC-50.
